title: A Spatially Resolved [C II] Survey of 31 z ∼ 7 Massive Galaxies Hosting Luminous Quasars
question: What are the [C II] and FIR continuum properties, sizes, kinematics, dynamical masses and SMBH-host relations of host galaxies of 31 luminous z>6.5 quasars?

what.value: Mg II redshifts and M1450 of quasars

evidence.quote: References for the quasar discovery (first number) and for $z_{\rm MgII}$ and $M_{\rm 1450}$ measurements (second number).

what.value: Mg II black hole masses for the quasars

evidence.quote: are measured from the Mg II emission line and are collected from the literature (cite: Banados21; Wang21b; Yang21)

what.value: [C II]/FIR properties and kinematics of z>5.7 quasars from the literature

evidence.quote: There are 65 $z>5.7$ quasars with [C II] and FIR continuum observations in the literature at the time of doing our analyses.

recipe.goal: Image ALMA data and extract spectra
recipe.method: tclean dirty map, cubes at ~30 km/s, 1.5'' aperture 1D spectra fitted with flat continuum plus Gaussian

recipe.goal: Make [C II] line and continuum maps and measure 2D flux and size
recipe.method: collapse ±1.4 sigma_line (~83% flux, corrected), imfit 2D Gaussian

recipe.goal: Derive L_[CII], L_FIR, SFR, dust mass, C+ mass
recipe.method: Luminosity equation; graybody and Haro 11 templates; De Looze14 and Murphy11 SFR relations; dust mass with CMB correction
key_parameters: T_dust=47 K, beta=1.6; T_ex=100 K for C+

recipe.goal: Classify kinematics and estimate dynamical masses
recipe.method: re-image with robust 0.5, moment maps with immoments, v_proj/2sigma_int>0.4 criterion; thin-disk M_dyn and Neeleman21 relation

evidence.quote: correlation coefficient of $\rho=0.43$ and a chance probability of $p=1.7\times10^{-4}$
